200.description: Successful response containing the document content.

format.description: The format of the returned document.

content.description: markdown, MDX or JSON content used to update the document.
content.example:
# this is a h1 title
And this is a paragraph
- list item 1
- list item 2

description.description: OPTIONAL, set the description of the document.

previewImgURL.description: OPTIONAL, set the preview image URL of the document.

slug.description: OPTIONAL, set the slug (url key) of the document.

conditionalRuleId.description: OPTIONAL, set the conditional rule id.

hidden.description: OPTIONAL, set document as hidden or not.

docId.description: OPTIONAL, document id. If present and valid, the doc will be updated.

post.description: Submit a reader's email as a pending request to be added to the space's magic-link whitelist. The request does NOT grant access on its own — an admin must approve it. The space must be configured for Magic Link (Magic Link enabled, the portal gating content, and the team's plan allowing it); otherwise the request is refused with 400. There is one request per (email, space). A repeat request for the same email is idempotent per status: a Pending request returns the existing row unchanged; an Accepted request whose email is still whitelisted also returns it unchanged; but an Accepted request whose access was later revoked, or a previously Rejected request, is put back into the Pending queue and re-notifies the admins — so a rejected or revoked reader can always re-apply.
